question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as CCP General Secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman underpins the 95.9% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent personnel appointments, military leadership adjustments, and policy continuity through mid-2026 have shown no factional challenges or elite realignment capable of forcing an early exit ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Historical patterns tie major leadership shifts to scheduled congresses rather than abrupt ousters, while public appearances and diplomatic activity reflect stable control. Realistic scenarios that could still shift odds include an unforeseen medical event, a severe economic downturn prompting internal consensus against continued rule, or an external crisis that erodes elite cohesion before year-end 2026.
